column1: # Lemmas whose final l SSKJ² or Slovenski pravopis 2001 mark as [u̯] (mísel -sli [-u̯], vesél [-u̯],
# tôpel [-u̯]), among those Sloleks transcribes with [l]. Harvested from Fran.si on 2026-11-02, with
# medel, topel and svetel and their pre- forms and sivobel, preokrogel by their base word. Every other
# such word keeps [l] (ángel, módul, stíl, kábel, ansámbel; the dictionaries mark nothing there).
# slovenian_words.py leaves them out of the table SLOVENIAN_FINAL_L.
